column1: # DCOS arms with a LIVE delta-cosine term, for the split-half panel.
# WHY: F-loss2 measured +0.028..+0.034 on VALIDATION `best_metric` for 5/5 dcos weights,
# with an interior flat optimum at 0.5. Validation `best_metric` is NOT the split-half test
# `pearson_delta` the 0.3415 headline refers to, and the two have diverged before in this
# project. This grid converts the two best arms into comparable test numbers.
# QUESTION: does the DCOS validation gain survive to cell-eval on the 611 held-out HepG2
# perturbations? Positive -> DCOS is a real lever and the weight 0.5 is adoptable. Null ->
# `best_metric` and cell-eval disagree again, and DCOS is a validation-metric artefact.
# VARIED: delta_cos_weight (0.25 vs 0.5). HELD FIXED: lr 1e-3, decoder_lr 1e-3, cos 0.5,
# fmode-mult, fh256, fmf1, smooth_l1, seed 42, adjacency-map pert model, the 611-perturbation
# cohort, the 6,983-gene axis, the seeded control draw, quantile calibration.
# ANCHORS (test `pearson_delta`, all 5 splits): ctrlcell -0.0018 · ctrlmean 0.0016 ·
# meanpert 0.1324 · transfer 0.2323 · OURS 0.3415 · experimental 0.3722.
# ⚠️ The BASELINE to read these against is the INERT twin already scored by job 18179618:
# L11 has the SAME config hash as D02, and L12 the same as D03 -- they differ only in the
# git_sha that made the term live. That is the exact A/B, so compare D02 vs L11 and
